title: Proper direct image preserves universal derived coefficient arrows
statement: Let f:X→Y be a proper morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism] and let φ:A→B be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings. In the ordinary unbounded derived categories of sheaves of modules on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], let K∈D⁺(X,A), M∈D⁺(X,B), and let η:K→U_X M exhibit M as derived scalar extension: for every N∈D(X,B), composition η followed by U_X(-) is a bijection Hom(M,N)→Hom(K,U_X N) [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write d:Rf_*^B U_Y→U_X Rf_*^A for the canonical restriction/direct-image comparison [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons], with the usual functor composition convention. Then Rf_*^A(η) followed by d_M inverse, considered in the ambient category D(Y,A), is a universal scalar-extension arrow from Rf_*^A K to U_Y(Rf_*^B M), against every N∈D(Y,B). No Noetherian hypothesis or coefficient-flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the scalar adjunction to identify the supplied universal presentation (M, eta) with actual scalar extension of K, by the unique comparison whose restricted composite with the scalar unit is eta. Its inverse is obtained from the two universal Hom bijections. No arbitrary existence witness is chosen.

The source is K in D+ and its scalar extension is isomorphic to M, hence bounded below. The finite-ring proper projection formula identifies (Rf_* K) tensor_A^L B with Rf_*(K tensor_A^L B), and the latter is bounded below because restriction is exact and commutes with Rf_* on D+. The scalar/tensor identification and reflection of zero homology through exact faithful restriction give a bounded-below scalar extension of Rf_* K. Thus all three bounds of lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection hold.

Take the B-linear mate of the canonical scalar/pullback comparison. Under scalarTensorIso and the restriction/direct-image comparison its restriction is precisely the projection morphism, by lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection. Every other factor in that identity is invertible. The proper projection formula makes the projection morphism invertible and exact restriction reflects isomorphisms, so the B-linear mate is invertible.

Apply lem-r2-etale-scalar-mate-normalization to identify the scalar unit on Rf_* K followed by restriction of the scalar mate and Rf_* of the presentation isomorphism with Rf_* eta followed by the inverse bounded restriction comparison, including the exact-versus-derived inclusion isomorphisms. The scalar adjunction unit is universal against all ambient B-complexes. Postcompose with the proved B-linear isomorphism and transport along the D+ inclusion isomorphisms. This gives the displayed canonical universal arrow.

theorem properCoefficientUniversal
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    {K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))}
    {M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))}
    (η : K ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj M)
    (hη : Sheaf.IsDerivedBaseChange η.hom) :
    Sheaf.IsDerivedBaseChange
      (((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map η ≫
        (asIso (rightDerivedLowerStarRestrictScalars φ f)).inv.app M).hom)
